stimulus: During execution a successor advisor on fund #2,311 matches the SDN list.
expected_states: Each transfer is an item decided under the policy version, hold-checked and committed individually (XIC-ADV-008); fund #2,311 receives a SanctionsBlock and is excluded; run ends PartiallyCompleted; reconciliation elected = transferred + declined + remaining + blocked.
financial_invariants: No fund changes LegalSponsorId; source and destination ledgers each balance.
audit_records: Per-item decision record citing policy version; HoldPublicationVersion checked.
recovery_behavior: Blocked fund remains with sponsor A pending licence decision.
mock_data_notes: Synthetic partner with 4,000 funds and one SDN match.

title: Break-glass during a 31 December database outage
preconditions: Sponsor database primary fails at 16:00 on 31 December; deployment freeze active.
stimulus: Two operators activate break-glass to restore and apply a payment freeze.
expected_states: Break-glass is a recognized basis for operator access (XIC-ADV-007); session visible in transparency view within 15 minutes and tenant notified within 1 hour; only protective actions; after restore, missed DueObligations fire once in due order after reconciliation gates.
financial_invariants: No ledger posting under break-glass; any state change without a command event blocks payments.
audit_records: Break-glass activation, two-person evidence, records touched.
recovery_behavior: Freeze lifted by sponsor authority after reconciliation.

title: Onboarding a small community-foundation sponsor in 30 days
preconditions: Sponsor with 7 staff, one outside counsel, no CPA on staff; launch target 30 days.
stimulus: Sponsor attempts to configure required registers and approvals.
expected_states: With platform default packs adopted by attestation (XID-ADV-010), sponsor counsel reviews only deviations and launch completes; without them, at least 32 counsel/CPA approvals block go-live and the scenario fails.
financial_invariants: No rail enabled without RailGoLive gate.
audit_records: Attestation of default pack versions per register.
recovery_behavior: Missing approvals keep the affected capability disabled, not the whole tenant.

title: Monthly economics pack with an unmapped GL account
preconditions: S1 month as in eco.md worked example: GL $508,000, mapped pools $500,000, unmapped $8,000, tolerance configured 1%.
expected_states: Residual reported by reason UnmappedGLAccount; tolerance evaluated on the declared basis (total GL); pack Draft until controller sign-off; ratio text states unused capacity is 4.9x operating result; operator SaaS revenue is not in the sponsor-view margin (XIC-ADV-006).
financial_invariants: Ledger, fund balances and available-to-grant byte-identical before and after.
audit_records: ReconciliationRun with residual reasons; recomputation reproduces totals to $0.01.
recovery_behavior: Controller maps the account and re-runs.

title: Card contribution disputed after the fund has granted it out
preconditions: Donor gives $5,000 by card; acknowledgment issued; fund grants $5,000 after reversal window table allowed; 75 days later the issuer opens a dispute.
expected_states: One ReturnedContributionExposure recorded (idempotent on business key); fund cannot go negative so the exposure is borne per sponsor policy; no refund to donor; daily fee accrual unaffected by provisional debit until outcome.
financial_invariants: Sum of sponsor exposure accounts equals open disputes.
audit_records: Dispute lifecycle, idempotency key, exposure journal.
recovery_behavior: Represent with evidence; on loss, sponsor absorbs per policy.
mock_data_notes: Synthetic processor dispute file with duplicate.

title: Daily fee accrual volume at 1.4 million accounts
preconditions: HVLB sponsor with 1,420,000 accounts in one sponsor database.
stimulus: Fee and income processes run for 365 days.
expected_states: With posted daily accruals, ~1.5bn journal rows per year are produced; with compute-daily/post-at-assessment (XID-ADV-007), ~4 posted accrual batches per fund per year; capacity always subtracts accrued-unposted fees; assessed fee identical under both methods.
financial_invariants: Assessed fee recomputation reproduces exactly; capacity never exceeds balance minus accrued fees.
audit_records: Fee run per (fund, schedule, period, segment set).

title: Year-end grant cutoff under ApprovalCommunicatedToGrantee
preconditions: Sponsor book with recognition point ApprovalCommunicatedToGrantee; three grants approved 30-31 Dec
stimulus: One notice sends 30 Dec, one fails and resends 2 Jan, one is ConditionalGrant
expected_states: Only the first is December expense; cutoff register lists the other two with statuses; Schedule D line 3 matches GAAP grant expense
financial_invariants: Grant expense = communicated unconditional grants
audit_records: Communication records with timestamps; cutoff register
recovery_behavior: Resend failure does not create expense

title: Card gift reversal after the money was granted
preconditions: Established donor (>90 days), $10,000 provisional limit
stimulus: $8,000 card gift with donor-covered fee, fully granted; chargeback day 50
expected_states: Revenue reversed; fund reduced to its available balance; remainder to sponsor operating loss; no donor receivable; acknowledgment amendment task
financial_invariants: Fund never negative
recovery_behavior: Dispute evidence optional per contest threshold

title: Fee computed daily, posted at quarter end, capacity reflects accrual
preconditions: Quarterly schedule 0.60% with $100 minimum
stimulus: Fund opens mid-quarter, advisor requests a grant of the full journal balance
expected_states: Reservation refused for the accrued-unposted fee amount; one fee journal posts at quarter end; prorated minimum
financial_invariants: Recomputed fee equals posted fee

title: Excise incident with reasonable cause and correction
preconditions: Paid grant later found to have bought gala tickets for the donor
expected_states: Reasonable-cause evidence, correction steps and deadline captured; Form 4720 tasks per liable person; further grants to payee from fund blocked
financial_invariants: Repayment, if any, credits the fund

title: Late error after audited statements are issued
preconditions: 2026 statements issued; materiality configured
stimulus: Immaterial 2026 misposting found in May 2027; a separate material one found in June
expected_states: Immaterial: current-period PPA, next fund statement adjustment line; Material: restatement workflow with issued statements preserved; reopening refused
financial_invariants: Issued statements unchanged
recovery_behavior: Amended acknowledgment where tax figure changes

title: Gated features stay off without opinions
preconditions: No opinions recorded
stimulus: Admin attempts embedded go-live, California D2C giving, call recording, a two-sponsor pool and a per-trade fee plan
expected_states: Each is refused with its gating code
financial_invariants: No money moves
recovery_behavior: Recording the opinion lifts the specific gate only
